{{short description|Norwegian writer and biologist (born 1956)}}
[[File:Dag Olav Hessen, vinner Akademikerprisen 2010.jpg|thumb|Dag Olav Hessen]]
'''Dag Olav Hessen''' (born 6 July 1956) is a [[Norway|Norwegian]] writer and biologist, known for his work in the field of [[ecology]].

He is a member of the [[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.dnva.no/c26848/artikkel/vis.html?tid=27628|title=Gruppe 5: Biologi|publisher=[[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]]|language=Norwegian|accessdate=28 October 2009|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171017201516/http://www.dnva.no/c26848/artikkel/vis.html?tid=27628|archive-date=17 October 2017|url-status=dead}}</ref> He was awarded the [[Riksmål Society Literature Prize]] in 2008,{{citation needed|date=December 2010}} and the [[Fritt Ord Award|Fritt Ord Honorary Award]] in 2010.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.frittord.no/en/priser/fritt-ords-honnor-ind/fritt-ords-honnor-2010/|title=The Freedom of Expression Tribute 2010|publisher=[[Fritt Ord (organization)|Fritt Ord]]|date=8 December 2010|accessdate=12 March 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180123191111/http://www.frittord.no/en/priser/fritt-ords-honnor-ind/fritt-ords-honnor-2010/|archive-date=23 January 2018|url-status=dead}}</ref>
